name: Adults with a high-school credential
source: Census Reporter city profile, reproducing U.S. Census Bureau 2024 ACS 5-year educational-attainment estimate for Carmel-by-the-Sea
notes: The directly opened profile identifies the place as Carmel-by-the-Sea (Census place GEOID 0611250), states ACS 2024 5-year (2020–2024), and reports 94% (2,863 ±425.4) high-school graduate or higher. The captured profile data identifies Census ACS table B15002 with universe population age 25 and over. Tier 1 City searches found no adopted attainment series; Tier 2 official data.census.gov and Census API were attempted but were inaccessible/rendered without extractable cells. Census Reporter is a tier-3 secondary interface to Census data; its margin of error is large (±13.6 percentage points), so interpret cautiously.
